name: publicWeb_getMultiKennelRuns
description: Returns upcoming or past runs for a comma-separated list of kennel slugs (KennelUniqueShortName). Each row carries the kennel's name, logo, colours and IANA timezone so mixed-kennel lists render kennel badges without a second call. Unknown, deleted or removed slugs are silently ignored. Upcoming = EventStartDatetimeGmt within the last 8 hours or later, ascending; past = before now, descending; optional @MaxEvents cap and @DaysOffset boundary. Description, URL and what3words are always NULL (list use only). Rowset 0 is a count sentinel so an empty list is not read as a 404. No authentication. Read-only.

parameters.name: SlugList
parameters.description: Comma-separated KennelUniqueShortName values (STRING_SPLIT on ',', each trimmed). Required — blank → ValidationError. No SQL default.

parameters.name: IsFuture
parameters.description: 1 = return upcoming events (start >= 8 hours ago, i.e. same-day runs still visible). 0 = return past events (start < now). No SQL default.

parameters.name: MaxEvents
parameters.description: Maximum number of event rows to return. NULL = no cap (returns all matching events). Must be > 0 when provided — returns { Success=0, ErrorMessage } otherwise. Default NULL.

parameters.name: DaysOffset
parameters.description: Relative date boundary in days from today. Always positive — direction determined by @IsFuture (forward for upcoming, backward for past). NULL = no boundary date limit. Must be > 0 when provided — returns { Success=0, ErrorMessage } otherwise. Default NULL.

rowsets.name: ValidationError
rowsets.description: Instead of the normal rowsets when a guard fails (SlugList blank; MaxEvents <= 0; DaysOffset <= 0; lines 36-51). Not logged to HC.ErrorLog. The SP returns.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Fixed text describing the bad input.

rowsets.name: TotalCount
rowsets.description: Always exactly one row on success: COUNT of matching runs before the @MaxEvents cap.

columns.name: TotalMatchingEvents
columns.description: COUNT(*) of events matching the slug list, IsFuture direction, and DaysOffset boundary — before the @MaxEvents cap is applied. Callers use this for pagination display ('showing N of M events').

rowsets.name: Events
rowsets.description: One row per matching run, at most @MaxEvents, ORDER BY EventStartDatetimeGmt ASC (upcoming) or DESC (past). May be empty (rowset 0 still has one row).

columns.name: KennelSlug
columns.description: Kennel.KennelUniqueShortName — the kennel's URL slug.

columns.name: KennelName
columns.description: Kennel.KennelName — full kennel name.

columns.description: Kennel.KennelShortName — abbreviated kennel name for compact badge display.

columns.description: Kennel.KennelLogo URL, or NULL if the value is the default bundle URL ('bundle://defaultKennelLogo'). Clients should fall back to a default logo image when NULL.

columns.name: KennelPrimaryColor
columns.description: KennelWebsite.PrimaryColor — CSS colour string for kennel theming. NULL if no KennelWebsite row exists for the kennel.

columns.name: KennelAccentColor
columns.description: KennelWebsite.AccentColor — CSS colour string for kennel theming. NULL if no KennelWebsite row exists.

columns.description: CAST(Event.EventStartDatetime AS datetime2(7)) — timezone offset stripped. Client receives local time without UTC offset. Use KennelIANATimezone to reconstruct the offset if needed.

columns.name: EventEndDatetime
columns.description: CAST(Event.EventEndDatetime AS datetime2(7)) — timezone offset stripped. NULL when no end time is set.

columns.name: EventStartDatetimeGmt
columns.description: HC.Event.EventStartDatetimeGmt — the run's true UTC instant, maintained by trigger from Kennel → City → Timezone. The filter and sort key. Use it with KennelIANATimezone for display.

columns.name: KennelIANATimezone
columns.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. 'America/New_York') derived from the kennel's city via DomainValues.TimeZoneMap. NULL if no timezone mapping exists for the kennel's city. Used by clients to display local times correctly.

columns.name: EventTypeName

columns.name: EventCurrencyType
columns.description: COALESCE(Event.EventCurrencyType, Kennel.DefaultEventCurrencyType) — currency code (e.g. 'USD'). NULL when neither is set.

rowsets.name: CatchEnvelope
rowsets.description: On a runtime error (CATCH, line 285): { Success = 0, ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE() }, possibly after rowsets already sent. NOT logged to HC.ErrorLog and not re-raised.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: ERROR_MESSAGE().

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: The CATCH (lines 281-286) returns { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } without writing HC.ErrorLog and without THROW, so a timeout or bad input surfaces to the shim as a data rowset and leaves no server-side record (CLAUDE.md 'Every CATCH must log'). The temp table is dropped in the CATCH, so nothing leaks.

These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @IsFuture. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.
@SlugList is split on ',' (line 103). CLAUDE.md requires '|' for delimited list parameters; slugs cannot contain commas today, so this is convention, not a live bug.

codeSmells.issue: EventStartDatetime loses timezone offset via CAST to DATETIME2
codeSmells.detail: EventStartDatetime and EventEndDatetime are returned as DATETIME2(7) (CAST strips the offset, which on ~67% of rows is a spurious +00:00 anyway). That is the kennel's wall-clock time; EventStartDatetimeGmt (the instant) and KennelIANATimezone are returned alongside for display. Intended, but EventStartLocal is now the canonical wall-clock column.

The future boundary is DATEADD(HOUR, -8, @UtcNow) — events that started up to 8 hours ago are still treated as 'upcoming'. This allows same-day runs to remain visible for late joiners. Callers must be aware that 'IsFuture=1' includes recently-started events.
Three columns are placeholder NULLs: w3wJson, EventDescription, EventUrl. They consume no real resources but inflate the rowset schema and add dead contracts for callers that may try to read them.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 equivalent. First introduced for HC6 RunListBlock multi-kennel support.
